purpose: Identify the authoritative documents governed by Schedule 3 of the scheduled document reacquisition and regurgitation custom instruction.

documents.description: AI-NLE INSTRUCTION: Treat this document as the semantic-definition companion to the flattened MetaProcedure. The document root is a JSON array of 7,011 elements. For each array index i from 0 through 7010, read the object stored at definitions[i]. That object must contain the key equal to the decimal string form of i. The value at that key is the semantic definition of flattened_meta_procedure[i]. Use that definition to determine what the corresponding flattened MetaProcedure element means in its source context. Preserve the one-to-one index relationship: definitions[i] defines only flattened_meta_procedure[i]. Do not shift, reorder, merge, infer a different index, or substitute a neighboring definition. When this document is read for Schedule 3, read the complete JSON array and use its indexed definition values as the values-and-definitions population for the required Schedule 3 regurgitation exercise.
